title: Alberta Sports Hall of Fame

services.name: Class of 2026
services.desc: The Alberta Sports Hall of Fame is a great opportunity for students of all ages to experience and explore some of Alberta’s incredible sport history and heroes. Students will have the chance to see how sports, sports equipment, and athletes have evolved throughout the years. In all the school programs we offer this year we hope to inspire learning beyond the classroom. Students will be able to use the Hall as a new classroom through behind the scene tours, inquiry-based learning and hands-on activities.
